name: Lesotho

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and green, the white one widest, with a black Basotho hat in the centre of the white stripe.
flag.symbolism: Blue stands for the sky and rain, white for peace and green for prosperity; the mokorotlo hat represents the Basotho people.

hook: Lesotho's flag wears a hat: a black conical Basotho mokorotlo on a white band between blue and green.
trivia: Lesotho is entirely surrounded by South Africa, one of only three countries enclosed by a single other country.
Its lowest point is about 1,400 m above sea level, the highest low point of any country.
